device.basis: JPEG encoder of X-T20 2.11 (section 6 driver 0x1557390..0x15575ac, section 5 0xc6dbfc..0xc6e568; interrupt index 0x3c of table 0xed4720 is line 134). A still encodes the 160x120 EXIF thumbnail, a 320x240 preview and the main picture from 0x80000000 (markers 0x06028b00/0x06028a00). Quantization tables go word by word to +0x8c, the restart interval to +0x80, height << 16 | width to +0x44, the packed 4:2:2 source to +0x100, the destination to +0x10c and its limit to +0x110; +0x00 bit 0 starts a run and bit 8 resets. +0x24 bit 16 reads set; a finished run sets bit 4 (write 1 clears) and the stream size at +0x94. run_ticks (2 ms) is not measured.
